system.description: You can suppress chakra within a foe just by touching them. While a creature is Grappled by you, at the beginning of each of their turns, you can choose to make them make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take 3d6 chakra damage, and gain 1 rank of Sealed for the duration of the grapple. The damage increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels. Beginning at 11th level, the ranks of Sealed increases to 2. A Grappled creature that has a ranks of Sealed due to this effect, loses the ranks of Sealed gained by this effect, when they are no longer Grappled by you.
